$comment: The seventeen demo cases of the health claims desk. The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its members, its providers, its claims and its invoices. Every id, date and amount is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.

THE AGENT'S TASK

Everything here is as the health system holds it. The agent reads the invoice and the contract themselves from the health system.
